title: Tentacle-shape analysis says the 'jellyfish' are not drifting balloons (compared with Corbell's footage)

tellings.quote: What is interesting about objects of the 7th class, this what we have published images where their tentacles sometimes straight,

plain: A startup called Skywatcher, whose team tries to call up and record UFOs at its own field site, says that the "jellyfish" objects it filmed between 2023 and 2025 are not drifting balloons, because their tentacle-like parts are sometimes held straight. The team speaks as the people who took the images, which they place in what they call their "7th class" of objects and published, comparing them with jellyfish-like footage put out by Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who releases UFO videos. If they are right, the objects would be moving under their own control rather than blowing in the wind.
